sanskrit: bhūya eva ca rājendra śṛṇu me vacanaṃ hitam yathā sa devapravaraḥ kathāyām evam abravīt
english: And hear again, O lord of kings, my beneficial words — just as that foremost of gods spoke thus in the story.

sanskrit: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule jāto bhaviṣyati sudhārmikaḥ rājā daśaratho nāmnā śrīmān satyapratiśravaḥ
english: Born in the lineage of the Ikṣvākus there shall be a most righteous king named Daśaratha — glorious and true to his word.

sanskrit: aṅgarājena sakhyaṃ ca tasya rājño bhaviṣyati kanyā cāsya mahābhāgā śāntā nāma bhaviṣyati
english: That king will have a friendship with the king of Aṅga, and this king will have a greatly fortunate daughter named Śāntā.

sanskrit: putras tv aṅgasya rājñas tu lomapāda iti śrutaḥ taṃ sa rājā daśaratho gamiṣyati mahāyaśāḥ
english: The son of the king of Aṅga is known as Lomapāda; the greatly renowned King Daśaratha shall go to him.

sanskrit: anapatyo 'smi dharmātmañ śāntābhartā mama kratum āhareta tvayājñaptaḥ saṃtānārthaṃ kulasya ca
english: 'I am without a son, O righteous one; let Śāntā's husband, directed by you, perform the sacrificial rite for me, for the continuation of my lineage.'

sanskrit: śrutvā rājño 'tha tad vākyaṃ manasā sa vicintya ca pradāsyate putravantaṃ śāntā bhartāram ātmavān
english: Having heard the king's words and reflected on them in his mind, that self-possessed one will give Śāntā a husband who will bring sons.

sanskrit: pratigṛhya ca taṃ vipraṃ sa rājā vigatajvaraḥ āhariṣyati taṃ yajñaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
english: And having received that brāhmaṇa, the king, freed from his anguish, will perform that sacrifice with a heart full of joy.

sanskrit: taṃ ca rājā daśaratho yaṣṭukāmaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ varayiṣyati dharmavit
english: And King Daśaratha, desirous of performing the sacrifice and knowledgeable in dharma, will choose with joined palms that best of twice-born, Ṛśyaśṛṅga.

sanskrit: yajñārthaṃ prasavārthaṃ ca svargārthaṃ ca nareśvaraḥ labhate ca sa taṃ kāmaṃ dvijamukhyād viśāṃ patiḥ
english: For the purpose of the sacrifice, for offspring, and for heaven, that lord of men, that master of his people, will obtain his desired wish through that foremost of twice-born.

sanskrit: putrāś cāsya bhaviṣyanti catvāro 'mitavikramāḥ vaṃśapratiṣṭhānakarāḥ sarvalokeṣu viśrutāḥ
english: And he shall have four sons of immeasurable valour, establishers of the family line, renowned throughout all the worlds.

sanskrit: evaṃ sa devapravaraḥ pūrvaṃ kathitavān kathām sanatkumāro bhagavān purā devayuge prabhuḥ
english: Thus did that foremost of gods, the blessed Sanatkumāra, the lord, narrate this story of old in the age of the gods.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla tam ānaya susatkṛtam svayam eva mahārāja gatvā sabalavāhanaḥ
english: O tiger among men, O great king — go yourself with your army and retinue and bring him here, well-honoured.

sanskrit: anumānya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca sūtavākyaṃ niśamya ca sāntaḥpuraḥ sahāmātyaḥ prayayau yatra sa dvijaḥ
english: Having taken Vasiṣṭha's leave and heeding the sūta's words, he set out with his inner-palace household and ministers to where that brāhmaṇa dwelt.

sanskrit: vanāni saritaś caiva vyatikramya śanaiḥ śanaiḥ abhicakrāma taṃ deśaṃ yatra vai munipuṃgavaḥ
english: Crossing forests and rivers one by one, he gradually arrived at the region where that foremost sage resided.

sanskrit: āsādya taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ lomapādasamīpagam ṛṣiputraṃ dadarśādau dīpyamānam ivānalam
english: Approaching that best of twice-born who was near Lomapāda, he first beheld the son of the ṛṣi blazing like a fire.

sanskrit: tato rājā yathānyāyaṃ pūjāṃ cakre viśeṣataḥ sakhitvāt tasya vai rājñaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
english: Then the king honoured him duly and with especial distinction, out of friendship toward that king, with a heart overflowing with joy.

sanskrit: lomapādena cākhyātam ṛṣiputrāya dhīmate sakhyaṃ saṃbandhakaṃ caiva tadā taṃ pratyapūjayat
english: And Lomapāda explained to the wise son of the ṛṣi the bond of friendship and kinship between them; Ṛśyaśṛṅga then honoured Daśaratha in return.

sanskrit: evaṃ susatkṛtas tena sahoṣitvā nararṣabhaḥ saptāṣṭadivasān rājā rājānam idam abravīt
english: Thus well-honoured by him, that bull among men, the king, having dwelt there seven or eight days, said this to the king:

sanskrit: śāntā tava sutā rājan saha bhartrā viśāmpate madīyaṃ nagaraṃ yātu kāryaṃ hi mahad udyatam
english: 'O king, O lord of the people, let Śāntā, your daughter, go with her husband to my city — for a great task is at hand.'

sanskrit: tatheti rājā saṃśrutya gamanaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ uvāca vacanaṃ vipraṃ gaccha tvaṃ saha bhāryayā
english: Consenting with the word 'so be it' to the departure of that wise man, the king said to the brāhmaṇa: 'Go, with your wife.'

sanskrit: ṛṣiputraḥ pratiśrutya tathety āha nṛpaṃ tadā sa nṛpeṇābhyanujñātaḥ prayayau saha bhāryayā
english: The son of the ṛṣi, agreeing, said 'so be it' to the king; then, given leave by the king, he departed with his wife.

sanskrit: tāv anyonyāñjaliṃ kṛtvā snehāt saṃśliṣya corasā nanandatur daśaratho lomapādaś ca vīryavān
english: The two of them — Daśaratha and the valiant Lomapāda — clasped hands with each other and embraced chest to chest out of affection, and were glad.

sanskrit: tataḥ suhṛdam āpṛcchya prasthito raghunandanaḥ paurebhyaḥ preṣayām āsa dūtān vai śīghragāminaḥ kriyatāṃ nagaraṃ sarvaṃ kṣipram eva svalaṃkṛtam
english: Then, taking leave of his friend and setting out, the joy of the Raghus sent swift messengers ahead to the citizens: 'Let the entire city be quickly and handsomely adorned.'

sanskrit: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paurās te śrutvā rājānam āgatam tathā pracakrus tat sarvaṃ rājñā yat preṣitaṃ tadā
english: Then those joyful citizens, hearing that the king had come, did everything the king had sent word to do.

sanskrit: tataḥ svalaṃkṛtaṃ rājā nagaraṃ praviveśa ha śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaiḥ puraskṛtya dvijarṣabham
english: Then the king entered the handsomely adorned city to the sound of conches and kettledrums, placing the bull among twice-born at the head of the procession.

sanskrit: tataḥ pramuditāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāgarā dvijam praveśyamānaṃ satkṛtya narendreṇendrakarmaṇā
english: Then all the townspeople were overjoyed, seeing that brāhmaṇa being ushered in with honour by the king who acts like Indra.

sanskrit: antaḥpuraṃ praveśyainaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tu śāstrataḥ kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ mene tasyopavāhanāt
english: Having led him into the inner apartments and honoured him according to the scriptures, he considered himself fulfilled by the mere arrival of that sage.

sanskrit: antaḥpurāṇi sarvāṇi śāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāgatām saha bhartrā viśālākṣīṃ prītyānandam upāgaman
english: All the women of the inner apartments, seeing Śāntā arrive thus with her husband — she of wide eyes — were filled with delight and joy.

sanskrit: pūjyamānā ca tābhiḥ sā rājñā caiva viśeṣataḥ uvāsa tatra sukhitā kaṃ cit kālaṃ saha dvijā
english: Honoured by them and especially by the king, she lived there happily for some time together with the brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit: tataḥ kāle bahutithe kasmiṃś cit sumanohare vasante samanuprāpte rājño yaṣṭuṃ mano 'bhavat
english: Then, after a long time had passed and a certain delightful spring had arrived, the king's mind turned toward performing a sacrifice.

sanskrit: tataḥ prasādya śirasā taṃ vipraṃ devavarṇinam yajñāya varayām āsa saṃtānārthaṃ kulasya vai
english: Then, reverently bowing his head to that brāhmaṇa who was like a god in appearance, he chose him for the sacrifice — for the sake of progeny and the continuation of his lineage.

sanskrit: tatheti ca sa rājānam uvāca ca susatkṛtaḥ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantāṃ te turagaś ca vimucyatām
english: And he, well-honoured, said to the king: 'So be it.' 'Let your requisite materials be gathered and let the horse be released.'

sanskrit: tato rājābravīd vākyaṃ sumantraṃ mantrisattamam sumantrāvāhaya kṣipram ṛtvijo brahmavādinaḥ
english: Then the king spoke to Sumantra, the best of ministers: 'Sumantra, quickly summon the ritual officiants, the knowers of the Veda.'

sanskrit: tataḥ sumantras tvaritaṃ gatvā tvaritavikramaḥ samānayat sa tān viprān samastān vedapāragān
english: Then Sumantra, of swift movement, went quickly and assembled all those brāhmaṇas who had mastered the Veda.

sanskrit: suyajñaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālim atha kāśyapam purohitaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca ye cānye dvijasattamāḥ
english: Suyajña, Vāmadeva, Jābāli, Kāśyapa, the family priest Vasiṣṭha, and whatever other best among twice-born there were —

sanskrit: tān pūjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathas tadā idaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ vacanam abravīt
english: Having honoured them, the righteous-souled King Daśaratha then spoke these gentle words full of dharma and purpose:

sanskrit: mama lālapyamānasya putrārthaṃ nāsti vai sukham tadarthaṃ hayamedhena yakṣyāmīti matir mama
english: 'For me, yearning as I am, there is no happiness without a son. For that reason it is my intention to sacrifice with the horse sacrifice.'

sanskrit: tad ahaṃ yaṣṭum icchāmi śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā ṛṣiputraprabhāvena kāmān prāpsyāmi cāpy aham
english: 'I wish to perform the rite as prescribed by scripture. Through the power of the ṛṣi's son I shall attain my desires.'

sanskrit: tataḥ sādhv iti tad vākyaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ pratyapūjayan vasiṣṭhapramukhāḥ sarve pārthivasya mukhāc cyutam
english: Then all the brāhmaṇas, with Vasiṣṭha at their head, applauded that speech which had fallen from the king's mouth with the words: 'Excellent!'

sanskrit: ṛśyaśṛṅgapurogāś ca pratyūcur nṛpatiṃ tadā saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantāṃ te turagaś ca vimucyatām
english: With Ṛśyaśṛṅga at their head, they spoke to the king: 'Let your requisite materials be gathered and let the horse be released.'

sanskrit: sarvathā prāpyase putrāṃś caturo 'mitavikramān yasya te dhārmikī buddhir iyaṃ putrārtham āgatā
english: 'You will certainly obtain four sons of immeasurable valour, since this righteous resolve has arisen in you for the sake of sons.'

sanskrit: tataḥ prīto 'bhavad rājā śrutvā tad dvijabhāṣitam amātyāṃś cābravīd rājā harṣeṇedaṃ śubhākṣaram
english: Then the king was delighted hearing what the twice-born had said, and the king, with joy, spoke these auspicious words to his ministers:

sanskrit: gurūṇāṃ vacanāc chīghraṃ saṃbhārāḥ saṃbhriyantu me samarthādhiṣṭhitaś cāśvaḥ sopādhyāyo vimucyatām
english: 'By the word of the preceptors, let my requisite materials be quickly assembled, and let the horse, guarded by capable men with its chaplain, be released.'

sanskrit: sarayvāś cottare tīre yajñabhūmir vidhīyatām śāntayaś cābhivardhantāṃ yathākalpaṃ yathāvidhi
english: 'Let the sacrificial ground be prepared on the northern bank of the Sarayū, and let the auspicious rites be performed according to proper procedure and rule.'

sanskrit: śakyaḥ kartum ayaṃ yajñaḥ sarveṇāpi mahīkṣitā nāparādho bhavet kaṣṭo yady asmin kratusattame
english: 'This sacrifice can be performed by any king, but there must be no grievous fault in this best of rites —'

sanskrit: chidraṃ hi mṛgayante 'tra vidvāṃso brahmarākṣasāḥ vidhihīnasya yajñasya sadyaḥ kartā vinaśyati
english: 'For learned brahma-rākṣasas seek out any flaw here; the performer of a sacrifice that is deficient in proper procedure is instantly destroyed.'

sanskrit: tad yathā vidhipūrvaṃ me kratur eṣa samāpyate tathāvidhānaṃ kriyatāṃ samarthāḥ karaṇeṣv iha
english: 'Therefore let the arrangements be made such that this rite of mine is completed according to proper procedure; let those who are capable attend to the execution.'

sanskrit: tatheti ca tataḥ sarve mantriṇaḥ pratyapūjayan pārthivendrasya tad vākyaṃ yathājñaptam akurvata
english: Then all the ministers applauded that speech of the lord of kings with the word 'so be it,' and carried out what had been commanded.

sanskrit: tato dvijās te dharmajñam astuvan pārthivarṣabham anujñātās tataḥ sarve punar jagmur yathāgatam
english: Then those twice-born praised the dharma-knowing bull among kings; having been given leave, they all returned the way they had come.

sanskrit: gatānāṃ tu dvijātīnāṃ mantriṇas tān narādhipaḥ visarjayitvā svaṃ veśma praviveśa mahādyutiḥ
english: After the twice-born had departed, the lord of men, of great splendour, dismissed those ministers and then entered his own palace.

sanskrit: punaḥ prāpte vasante tu pūrṇaḥ saṃvatsaro 'bhavat abhivādya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca nyāyataḥ pratipūjya ca
english: When spring arrived again, a full year had passed. Having saluted Vasiṣṭha and duly honoured him —

sanskrit: abravīt praśritaṃ vākyaṃ prasavārthaṃ dvijottamam yajño me kriyatāṃ vipra yathoktaṃ munipuṃgava
english: — he spoke these humble words to the best of twice-born for the purpose of obtaining offspring: 'Let the sacrifice be performed for me, O brāhmaṇa, as has been prescribed, O foremost of sages.'

sanskrit: yathā na vighnaḥ kriyate yajñāṅgeṣu vidhīyatām bhavān snigdhaḥ suhṛn mahyaṃ guruś ca paramo mahān
english: 'Let it be arranged that no obstacle arises in the limbs of the sacrifice. You are my affectionate friend, and the greatest and most eminent preceptor.'

sanskrit: voḍhavyo bhavatā caiva bhāro yajñasya codyataḥ tatheti ca sa rājānam abravīd dvijasattamaḥ
english: 'The burden of this sacrifice, now set in motion, must be borne by you.' And the best of twice-born said to the king: 'So be it.'

sanskrit: kariṣye sarvam evaitad bhavatā yat samarthitam tato 'bravīd dvijān vṛddhān yajñakarmasu niṣṭhitān
english: 'I shall do all of this that you have resolved upon.' Then he spoke to the senior brāhmaṇas who were established in sacrificial duties:

sanskrit: sthāpatye niṣṭhitāṃś caiva vṛddhān paramadhārmikān karmāntikāñ śilpakārān vardhakīn khanakān api
english: — to those well-established in architecture and construction, the senior and most pious ones; to the overseers of works, craftsmen, carpenters, and diggers —

sanskrit: gaṇakāñ śilpinaś caiva tathaiva naṭanartakān tathā śucīñ śāstravidaḥ puruṣān subahuśrutān
english: — to astrologers and artisans, similarly to actors and dancers, to pure men who were learned in the scriptures and widely read —

sanskrit: yajñakarma samīhantāṃ bhavanto rājaśāsanāt iṣṭakā bahusāhasrī śīghram ānīyatām iti
english: 'By the king's command, let all of you attend to the sacrificial work. Let bricks by the many thousands be quickly brought.'

sanskrit: aupakāryāḥ kriyantāṃ ca rājñāṃ bahuguṇānvitāḥ brāhmaṇāvasathāś caiva kartavyāḥ śataśaḥ śubhāḥ
english: 'And let the reception halls for the kings, furnished with many amenities, be built; let auspicious lodging-houses for brāhmaṇas be constructed by the hundreds.'

sanskrit: bhakṣyānnapānair bahubhiḥ samupetāḥ suniṣṭhitāḥ tathā paurajanasyāpi kartavyā bahuvistarāḥ
english: 'Provided with abundant food and drink and well-established — and for the townspeople as well, let many spacious halls be made.'

sanskrit: āvāsā bahubhakṣyā vai sarvakāmair upasthitāḥ tathā jānapadasyāpi janasya bahuśobhanam
english: 'Dwellings with abundant food, provided with all desired amenities — and let there be much splendour for the country folk as well.'

sanskrit: dātavyam annaṃ vidhivat satkṛtya na tu līlayā sarve varṇā yathā pūjāṃ prāpnuvanti susatkṛtāḥ
english: 'Food is to be given according to proper rule, with honour — not carelessly — so that all classes of people are duly honoured and receive their proper respect.'

sanskrit: na cāvajñā prayoktavyā kāmakrodhavaśād api yajñakarmasu ye 'vyagrāḥ puruṣāḥ śilpinas tathā
english: 'And no disrespect is to be shown even under the sway of desire or anger toward those men who are diligently engaged in the sacrificial duties, nor toward the craftsmen.'

sanskrit: teṣām api viśeṣeṇa pūjā kāryā yathākramam yathā sarvaṃ suvihitaṃ na kiṃ cit parihīyate
english: 'They especially are to be honoured in due order, so that everything is well-arranged and nothing at all is neglected.'

sanskrit: tathā bhavantaḥ kurvantu prītisnigdhena cetasā tataḥ sarve samāgamya vasiṣṭham idam abruvan
english: 'Act thus, all of you, with an affectionate and loving mind.' Then all of them assembled and said this to Vasiṣṭha:

sanskrit: yathoktaṃ tat kariṣyāmo na kiṃ cit parihāsyate tataḥ sumantram āhūya vasiṣṭho vākyam abravīt
english: 'We shall do everything as instructed; nothing at all shall be neglected.' Then Vasiṣṭha, having called Sumantra, spoke these words:

sanskrit: nimantrayasya nṛpatīn pṛthivyāṃ ye ca dhārmikāḥ brāhmaṇān kṣatriyān vaiśyāñ śūdrāṃś caiva sahasraśaḥ
english: 'Invite the kings on the earth who are righteous, and brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras by the thousands.'

sanskrit: samānayasva satkṛtya sarvadeśeṣu mānavān mithilādhipatiṃ śūraṃ janakaṃ satyavikramam
english: 'Assemble and honour men from all lands. Bring the valiant lord of Mithilā, Janaka, true in his valour —'

sanskrit: niṣṭhitaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu tathā vedeṣu niṣṭhitam tam ānaya mahābhāgaṃ svayam eva susatkṛtam pūrvasaṃbandhinaṃ jñātvā tataḥ pūrvaṃ bravīmi te
english: '— who is versed in all the scriptures and likewise versed in the Vedas. Bring that greatly fortunate one, yourself, with due honour; knowing him to be an old kinsman, I speak of him first to you.'

sanskrit: tathā kāśipatiṃ snigdhaṃ satataṃ priyavādinam sadvṛttaṃ devasaṃkāśaṃ svayam evānayasva ha
english: 'Similarly, the lord of Kāśī — affectionate, ever speaking pleasantly, of good conduct and god-like in appearance — bring him yourself.'

sanskrit: tathā kekayarājānaṃ vṛddhaṃ paramadhārmikam śvaśuraṃ rājasiṃhasya saputraṃ tam ihānaya
english: 'Also, the aged and most righteous king of the Kekayas, father-in-law of this lion among kings — bring him here with his son.'

sanskrit: aṅgeśvaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ lomapādaṃ susatkṛtam vayasyaṃ rājasiṃhasya tam ānaya yaśasvinam
english: 'The greatly fortunate lord of Aṅga, Lomapāda — who is to be honoured greatly and is the friend of this lion among kings — bring that illustrious one.'

sanskrit: prācīnān sindhusauvīrān saurāṣṭhreyāṃś ca pārthivān dākṣiṇātyān narendrāṃś ca samastān ānayasva ha
english: 'Bring all of them — the kings of the east, of Sindhu and Sauvīra, the kings of Saurāṣṭra, and all the lords of men in the south.'

sanskrit: santi snigdhāś ca ye cānye rājānaḥ pṛthivītale tān ānaya yathākṣipraṃ sānugān sahabāndhavān
english: 'And whatever other affectionate kings there are on the surface of the earth — bring them as quickly as possible, with their retinues and kinsmen.'

sanskrit: vasiṣṭhavākyaṃ tac chrutvā sumantras tvaritas tadā vyādiśat puruṣāṃs tatra rājñām ānayane śubhān
english: Having heard those words of Vasiṣṭha, Sumantra at once dispatched capable men there to bring the kings.

sanskrit: svayam eva hi dharmātmā prayayau muniśāsanāt sumantras tvarito bhūtvā samānetuṃ mahīkṣitaḥ
english: For the righteous-souled Sumantra himself, acting swiftly by the sage's command, went to assemble the lords of the earth.

sanskrit: te ca karmāntikāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhāya ca dhīmate sarvaṃ nivedayanti sma yajñe yad upakalpitam
english: And all the overseers of the works reported to the wise Vasiṣṭha everything that had been prepared for the sacrifice.

sanskrit: tataḥ prīto dvijaśreṣṭhas tān sarvān punar abravīt avajñayā na dātavyaṃ kasya cil līlayāpi vā avajñayā kṛtaṃ hanyād dātāraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
english: Then the best of twice-born, pleased, spoke again to all of them: 'Nothing is to be given to anyone with disrespect or carelessly, for what is given with disrespect destroys the giver — there is no doubt in this.'

sanskrit: tataḥ kaiś cid ahorātrair upayātā mahīkṣitaḥ bahūni ratnāny ādāya rājño daśarathasya ha
english: Then within a few days and nights, the lords of the earth arrived, bringing many jewels and treasures for King Daśaratha.

sanskrit: tato vasiṣṭhaḥ suprīto rājānam idam abravīt upayātā naravyāghra rājānas tava śāsanāt
english: Then Vasiṣṭha, greatly pleased, said this to the king: 'O tiger among men, the kings have arrived at your command.'

sanskrit: mayāpi satkṛtāḥ sarve yathārhaṃ rājasattamāḥ yajñiyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājan puruṣaiḥ susamāhitaiḥ
english: 'By me also all the best of kings have been honoured as they deserve. And the sacrificial ground, O king, has been made ready by men of concentrated minds.'

sanskrit: niryātu ca bhavān yaṣṭuṃ yajñāyatanam antikāt sarvakāmair upahṛtair upetaṃ vai samantataḥ
english: 'And let your majesty proceed to the sacrificial enclosure nearby, which is provided on all sides with all desired offerings brought.'

sanskrit: tathā vasiṣṭhavacanād ṛśyaśṛṅgasya cobhayoḥ śubhe divasa nakṣatre niryāto jagatīpatiḥ
english: In accordance with the words of both Vasiṣṭha and Ṛśyaśṛṅga, on an auspicious day and under an auspicious asterism, the lord of the earth set forth.

sanskrit: tato vasiṣṭhapramukhāḥ sarva eva dvijottamāḥ ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ puraskṛtya yajñakarmārabhaṃs tadā
english: Then all those best of twice-born, with Vasiṣṭha at their head, placing Ṛśyaśṛṅga in the lead, thereupon commenced the work of the sacrifice.
